messages:
support_elaine: FYI escalation from Maya at FinKit — after the v5-small canary we started seeing consumers fail to parse JSON outputs. They say an extra top-level wrapper 'response_body' appeared and order_id types flipped to strings/nulls, causing webhook 422s and retries.
customer_maya: quick example from our prod webhook logs — we expect {order_id: 123, items: [...]}. Instead we got either a nested wrapper or nulls which blows up our parser and triggers retries.
support_elaine: pasting a minimal repro curl and the server response we received.
customer_maya: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"v5-small","mode":"json","prompt":"generate order payload"}'
customer_maya: response (200 OK) body:
```
{"response_body": {"order": {"id": "123", "total": 49.95}}}
```
customer_maya: sometimes the body is `{"response_body": null}` which our parser treats as missing required keys.
eng_ashok: thx. Need the request headers when you saw that — specifically `x-rw-request-id` and `x-rw-model-version`. Also, any evidence of streaming/chunking?
support_elaine: customer provided x-rw-request-id: rw-20260310-9a7, x-rw-model-version: v5-small-canary-1, canary=true, timestamp 2026-03-10T15:02:13Z. No streaming on their side; single POST.
eng_lina: I can repro on canary: the new structured-output shim introduced a "wrap_structured" flag that by mistake defaults to true when the canary annotation is present. That causes us to serialize the model output into {"response_body": <structured>} to support experimental metadata, but the API contract for `mode=json` expects the model to return the bare object.
eng_ashok: root cause looks like muxing code in handlers/structured_mux.go — when canary=true we flip wrapper on. Should only apply for the `structured_sampling` feature, not `json` mode.
sre_jordan: customer also reports a big uptick in requests because their ingestion retries on 422s, causing a billing spike. We should consider provisional credit and a temporary mitigation.
support_elaine: Maya, can you try passing `?structured_output=false` as a temporary workaround or pin `model_version=v4-stable` to avoid canary behavior?
customer_maya: adding `?structured_output=false` returned the flat payload we expect and their webhook resumed. They still want the canary eventually but need a fix.
eng_lina: plan: revert the canary default on the shim, add explicit gate so `mode=json` cannot be wrapped, and add unit/integration tests. I'll open a PR and cut a patch to canary within ~2 hours. Also adding telemetry to count wrapper occurrences per-route.
infra_bot: deploybot: initiated rollback job db-9921 for canary:v5-small -> target 2 nodes (started).
eng_ashok: mitigation + customer guidance summarized: 1) advise pinning model_version or set structured_output=false, 2) eng to revert and add safety checks, 3) SRE/billing to assess retry-driven usage and offer credit.
sre_jordan: opening billing case BK-4479, provisional credit for FinKit. I'll follow up with numbers by EOD.
support_elaine: adding repro notes to the ticket and linking the infra rollback job. Will communicate ETA to FinKit.
eng_lina: patch merged to canary, added assert that `mode=json` bypasses wrapper. Monitoring alert created: `structured.wrapper.mismatch` -> pages eng on >5 occurrences in 1m.
support_elaine: FinKit confirmed webhook resumed after their switch. They want a postmortem on the gating for canaries.
customer_maya: appreciate the fast support and the credit. One ask — can you add a compatibility guard so future canaries can't silently change shape?
eng_ashok: yes — we'll add a contract test during canary rollout that validates structured_output shape for a subset of routes.
support_elaine: closing loop for now. Reopen if FinKit sees any new failures. :white_check_mark:
